title: Climate policy debate (sample subtitles)
text: We need to mitigate the environmental impact of rapid urbanisation. Policy makers face mounting pressure to ratify ambitious climate agreements. The issue remains contentious among delegates from emerging economies. Without a coherent framework, disparities in funding will only widen. Analysts caution that superficial reforms cannot substantiate long-term resilience.
